recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not reintroduce FHIR-5344's old SHALL NOT wording unless a future work-group decision reverses FHIR-13870/FHIR-17802/FHIR-18483.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive DSTU1 technical correction from the January 2015 ballot asking to change the References-page wording from contained resources SHOULD not contain any narrative to SHALL NOT contain narrative, matching the then-current Narrative page statement that contained resources SHALL NOT have narrative of their own.
initial_application: The git-svn mirror commit b96ed091e13d3289a60376e042a6974a574aa807 for svn 4194 included #5344 and changed source/references.html from SHOULD not contain any narrative to SHALL NOT contain any narrative, so the original issue was applied in historical source.
additional_context: FHIR-13870 later dropped the invariant preventing contained-resource narrative and added the rule now present on the References page: contained resources can contain narrative, but their narrative is ignored when rendering the containing resource and relevant information SHALL appear in the containing resource narrative. FHIR-17802 and FHIR-18483 then removed stale no-contained-narrative text. Those related decisions are already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current active source is correct under the later issue family: source/references.html permits contained-resource narrative, source/narrative.html has no old prohibition, and DomainResource comments no longer say contained resources do not have narrative.
